method: OLS trend per grid cell with an autocorrelation-adjusted 95% interval and a Mann-Kendall test (core.summary). For a circle, the server takes the cells whose centre is inside it (ADR 0005) and corrects them together with Benjamini-Hochberg; a cell rises or falls clearly only when both tests are significant after that (ADR 0009).
